declaration.preface:
Raichem Medicare Pvt. Ltd. recognises that respect for human rights and fair labour practices are essential to ethical business conduct and long-term sustainability. The Company is committed to ensuring that all individuals working for or on its behalf are treated with dignity, fairness, and respect, and that their rights are safeguarded across all operations.

This Labour and Human Rights Policy outlines Raichem’s principles and expectations relating to lawful employment, equal opportunity, safe and healthy working conditions, and responsible labour practices. The policy is aligned with applicable labour laws and internationally recognised human rights standards and provides a framework for fostering an inclusive workplace that supports employee well-being, accountability, and responsible business growth.
declaration.declaration: Raichem Medicare Pvt. Ltd. is committed to upholding fundamental human and labour rights across its operations by ensuring fair wages, safe and healthy working conditions, equal opportunity, and full compliance with applicable labour laws. The Company strictly prohibits child labour, forced labour, discrimination, harassment, and unethical employment practices, and expects its employees, suppliers, and business partners to uphold these principles in line with responsible and ethical business conduct.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, business partners, and service providers engaged with Raichem across its operations. It governs all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment practices, wages and benefits, working hours, career development, workplace conditions, occupational health and safety, and overall employee well-being. All covered parties are required to comply with labour and human rights standards in alignment with the Company’s commitment to ethical, fair, and responsible business conduct.

focusAreas: Employees’ Health and Safety – Maintain a safe and healthy workplace through risk control and regular training.
Working Conditions – Provide respectful, clean, and ergonomically safe work environments.
Social Dialogue – Promote open communication, employee engagement, and effective grievance mechanisms.
Career Management and Training – Support continuous learning and career development through structured training.
Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Trafficking – Prohibit all forms of child labour, forced labour, and human trafficking across operations and the supply chain.
Non-Discrimination and Harassment – Prevent discrimination and harassment and ensure safe, confidential reporting without retaliation.
External Stakeholder Human Rights – Require suppliers and partners to uphold human rights and ethical labour standards.
Fair Wages & Benefits – Ensure lawful, timely, and fair compensation in line with statutory and industry standards.
Work-Life Balance – Encourage healthy work-life balance through flexible practices and wellness programs.

Employee Health and Safety: Foster a strong safety culture guided by ISO 45001 standards and proactive risk prevention across all plant operations.
Ensure continuous training on safe practices, hazard identification, and emergency preparedness for all employees and contractors.
Strengthen monitoring and reporting of health and safety performance to reduce incidents and improve workplace well-being.
Working Conditions: Ensure all workplaces meet statutory requirements related to cleanliness, ventilation, lighting, and welfare facilities.
Promote respectful supervision and ethical management practices at all levels of the organization.
Social Dialogue: Encourage open and transparent communication through structured internal channels.
Hold periodic labour–management interactions with documented discussions and follow-up actions.
Support employee representation and participation in workplace matters in line with applicable laws.
Career Management and Training: Encourage career progression and continuous growth aligned with company and individual goals.
Support employee development through structured learning opportunities and performance feedback.
Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Tra: Uphold zero tolerance for child labor, forced labor, discrimination, and unfair employment practices across operations.
Uphold dignity, fairness, and equal treatment for all employees and contract workers.
Conduct due diligence on suppliers and business partners regarding labor practices.
Non-Discrimination and Harassment: Maintain a respectful, inclusive, and professional workplace with zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, or abusive behavior.
Strengthen and continuously improve grievance redressal mechanisms to ensure fair, timely, and transparent resolution of concerns.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: Promote respect, dignity, and fair treatment across supply chain by embedding internationally recognized human rights principles in supplier engagement.
Strengthen ethical partnerships with suppliers and stakeholders by requiring compliance with labour laws, human rights expectations, and responsible business practices.
Fair Wages & Benefits: Ensure wages, benefits, and statutory contributions meet or exceed applicable legal and industry requirements.
Promote transparent wage structures and timely payment of salaries and benefits.
Periodically review compensation practices to ensure fairness, consistency, and compliance.
Work-Life Balance: Encourage a positive work culture that help employees balance professional and personal needs.
Support employee wellness through flexible practices and well-being initiatives.

policy.monitoring: Raichem Medicare Pvt. Ltd. undertakes continuous monitoring of its labour standards and human rights performance across key areas, including employee health and safety, working conditions, social dialogue, learning and career development, prevention of child and forced labour, non-discrimination and harassment, and the protection of external stakeholder human rights. Defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are tracked through established internal monitoring mechanisms, with performance reviewed quarterly and consolidated reporting provided to senior management to support informed and responsible decision-making. Annual assessments are conducted to evaluate overall progress, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions where required. Relevant information is communicated to appropriate stakeholders to enhance transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting processes are aligned with applicable labour laws, internationally recognised human rights principles, and industry best practices to ensure accuracy, consistency, and credibility.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed annually by the Human Resources Manager to assess its effectiveness and alignment with evolving labor standards, human rights commitments, and applicable legal requirements. Feedback from audits, employee input, and stakeholder consultations will be incorporated into updates. Necessary revisions will be made to strengthen labor and human rights practices and drive continuous improvement. Any significant changes or updates will be communicated to all employees and relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
